name: migrate_start
description: Begin OAuth authorization for Mailchimp or ConvertKit; pass an existing callback job_id for same-job OAuth reconnect.

name: migrate_credentials
description: Create a credential-backed migration job. Beehiiv requires an API key and explicit pub_ publication ID; Klaviyo requires a private API key and accepts an optional explicit account ID.

name: migrate_discover
description: Pre-flight source inventory. Mailchimp scoped discovery is informative; dry-run persists the authoritative selected audience scope.

name: migrate_dry_run
description: Start asynchronous verification without destination writes; Mailchimp selected_audience_ids becomes the authoritative reviewed scope.

name: migrate_commit
description: Execute the reviewed migration. Mailchimp repeats the exact dry-run audience scope; tracked writes have a 7-day conflict-aware rollback window.

name: migrate_status
description: Poll the raw migration job, including status, progress, authoritative audience scope, verification report, and rollback deadline.

name: migrate_source_session_refresh
description: Refresh a same-job encrypted source session after verifying the explicit source/job binding; credentials are never returned.

name: migrate_verification
description: Read the bound job's authoritative verification report; verification alone is not cutover acceptance.

name: migrate_delta_import
description: Run the approved post-freeze final delta import; poll completion before fresh checks or cutover evidence.

name: migrate_shadow_check
description: Compare fresh source discovery with the latest bound verification report and persist bounded shadow history.

name: migrate_shadow_monitor_start
description: Start approved recurring shadow checks for a source-bound completed migration during overlap.

name: migrate_shadow_monitor_status
description: Read a bound job's shadow monitor configuration and recent check history.

name: migrate_shadow_monitor_stop
description: Stop future shadow observations only with explicit approval after validating the source/job binding.

name: migrate_source_events_start
description: Start approved incremental ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, or Klaviyo source-event polling after validating the source/job binding.

name: migrate_source_events_status
description: Read the bound source-event monitor, continuity state, recent replay evidence, failures, and manual-review rows.

name: migrate_source_events_stop
description: Stop future source-event polling only with explicit approval after overlap, final snapshot, verification, and acceptance checks.

name: migrate_automation_rebuild_list
description: List the bound job's durable automation or Klaviyo flow rebuild, test, and waiver checklist.

name: migrate_automation_rebuild_update
description: Update one approved automation rebuild item with bounded, non-secret test or waiver evidence.

name: migrate_rollback_rehearsal
description: Generate and persist approved rollback-readiness evidence without executing a rollback.

name: migrate_pilot_acceptance
description: Read strict post-delta pilot acceptance; warnings or blockers mean the migration is not ready.

name: migrate_cutover_evidence
description: Record approved, non-secret ActiveCampaign, Beehiiv, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or Customer.io evidence only after the latest successful final delta or full snapshot.

name: migrate_rollback
description: Start an asynchronous rollback of tracked destination writes within 7 days without overwriting later edits or later-job ownership.

name: migrate_rollback_status
description: Poll asynchronous rollback state and per-resource deleted/total counters.

name: diagnose_campaign
description: Run the AI Diagnostician on a sent campaign. Returns a ranked list of fixes (each with severity, evidence, and a suggested action) for any deliverability issues observed across the seedlist.

name: predict_placement
description: Predict inbox placement (Primary / Promotions / Spam) for a draft email BEFORE you send. Takes raw HTML and a subject line.

name: check_reputation
description: Sender-reputation snapshot for the tenant's sending domain + IP. Returns SenderScore, blocklist status, and Postmaster Tools signals when available.

name: check_auth
description: Status of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI for the tenant's sending domain. Returns each record with pass/fail and a remediation hint when failing.

name: render_cross_client
description: Render an HTML email across major clients (Gmail web/mobile, Outlook desktop/web, Apple Mail, Yahoo) and return one preview URL per environment.

name: inbox_report
description: Full Inbox Reality report for a sent campaign: placement from the active controlled seed roster, opens/clicks per observed provider, and any auth/content signals that fired.

name: render_preview_html
description: Preview raw HTML across major email clients without saving anything. Wraps the same render pipeline as render_cross_client but takes HTML directly so an agent can iterate on a draft before any campaign object exists.

name: campaign_assurance_run
description: Start a durable, potentially billable Predicted Agent Comprehension run over an exact frozen campaign revision and send plan. This models comprehension; it does not observe Gmail, Gemini, or any recipient's inbox.

name: campaign_assurance_get
description: Read the latest applicable Campaign Assurance receipt or one exact run view. Source classes and the Predicted Agent Comprehension disclosure are returned unchanged.

name: campaign_assurance_apply_fix
description: After explicit user approval, apply only one server-stored deterministic Campaign Assurance patch under the exact strong campaign ETag the user reviewed. This creates a new immutable revision, marks the originating run stale, and requires assurance to run again.

name: campaign_assurance_override
description: Record an immutable owner/admin governed decision for one overridable finding. This does not fix content or change the certified artifact; allow_send requires a fresh matching finding and remains visible in the send receipt.

name: campaign_assurance_cancel
description: Cancel one queued or running Campaign Assurance run. Completed evidence remains immutable; cancellation cannot erase an existing receipt.

name: voice_profile_get
description: Fetch the tenant's current voice profile. Includes tonality vector, pacing, characteristic phrasings, and the list of ingested sources used to build it.

name: voice_source_add
description: Register a new ingestion source for voice training. URL-bearing sources (rss, url) are SSRF-validated. Pasted text is stored in-place.

name: voice_profile_build
description: Re-compute the voice profile from currently-ingested sources. Run after adding new sources via voice_source_add.

name: sequence_generate
description: Generate a multi-email sequence from one of the 50 templates, written in the tenant's voice. Returns a full Sequence with per-email fidelity scores.

name: sequence_regenerate_email
description: Regenerate a single email at the given position within a sequence. Pass an optional hint string to nudge the rewrite (e.g. 'shorter', 'more direct opening').

name: subscribers_list
description: Paginated subscriber list across the WHOLE tenant. Optional filters: q, status, page, per_page. There is no list filter here — use list_members to read the subscribers of one list. Returns items with email, status, consent metadata, tags, custom fields.

name: subscribers_search
description: Full-text search subscribers by email, name, or custom fields. Returns up to 100 matches.

name: subscriber_create
description: Create a single subscriber. Email is required. Custom fields and tags are optional. Idempotent on email (returns existing record if already present).

name: subscriber_suppress
description: Move a subscriber to the suppression list. Idempotent: subsequent calls are no-ops. Resolves the email to its subscriber ID first.

name: custom_field_create
description: Create a tenant-scoped custom field on the subscriber schema. `key` is the machine slug, `label` is the human display name, `type` is one of string/number/boolean/date. Returns the persisted field.

name: segment_create
description: Persist a saved segment from the Moosewave SegmentNode AST (and/or/not/leaf with field+comparator+value). Optional description is shown in the UI. Returns the segment id.

name: segment_list
description: List saved segments for the tenant, cursor-paginated. Returns id, name, query_ast, and created_at for each.

name: segment_delete
description: Delete a saved segment by id. Refused with 409 segment_in_use while a campaign that hasn't started sending uses the segment as its audience; the error names those campaigns, so move them to another audience (or delete them) and retry. A segment that no longer exists returns 404 not_found. Does not affect subscribers; only removes the saved query definition.

name: segment_compile_from_text
description: Compile a natural-language audience description (e.g. 'people who opened the last campaign but did not click') into a canonical SegmentNode AST. Pair with segment_create or segment_eval.

name: segment_eval
description: Evaluate a canonical Segment AST against the subscriber base. Returns the matching count and a sample of up to 25 subscriber records. Useful for previewing audience size before sending.

name: batch_subscriber_upsert
description: Upsert up to 1000 subscriber records in one call. Each record: {email (required), status?, first_name?, last_name?, custom_fields?, merge_fields?, tags?}. Idempotent on email; returns per-record created/updated/error outcomes. Use this instead of looping subscriber_create.

name: form_create
description: Create a hosted form. Toggle `double_optin: true` to require email confirmation. Returns the form ID, hosted URL, and embed snippet.

name: form_submissions_list
description: Paginated submissions for a form. Each submission includes timestamp, IP, user-agent, and the field values.

name: form_update
description: Patch an existing hosted form. Pass only the fields to change in `patch` (name, fields, double_optin, redirect_url, thank_you_message). Returns the updated form.

name: form_delete
description: Delete a hosted form by id. Existing submissions are retained but the public submit/embed URLs stop accepting new entries. Idempotent.

name: optin_confirm
description: Programmatically confirm a pending double-opt-in submission via its confirmation token (the same token sent in the confirmation email). Returns ok plus the resolved subscriber email.

name: automation_trigger
description: Fire a behavioral automation for a specific subscriber. Optional payload is passed to the first node's context.

name: automation_set_state
description: Pause or resume an automation. `action` must be 'pause' or 'resume'. Idempotent.

name: campaign_create
description: Draft a single-variant campaign. Body is MJML. Audience can be a list_id or a segment_id. Returns the campaign as a draft — call campaign_send to actually send.

name: campaign_send
description: Send a draft campaign immediately. The campaign must already be in 'draft' status with an audience attached.

name: campaign_create_ab
description: Configure an A/B test for a campaign: upsert 2-4 variants and (optionally) the settings (winner_metric, evaluation_window_hours, winner_recipients_pct). Each variant has a weight (any non-negative number — they'll be normalized).

name: campaign_ab_results
description: Per-variant aggregate results for an A/B campaign. Returns settings, all variants, per-variant counts (recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, complaints), and the winning variant id once a winner has been decided (95% confidence two-proportion z-test).

name: send_test_email
description: Send a one-off transactional message via the tenant's sending pipeline. Useful for previewing a draft body in a real inbox before promoting it to a campaign. Provide either body_html OR body_mjml (server compiles MJML).

name: campaign_template_search
description: Search every page of the visual newsletter design library with stable filters, sorting, and opaque cursor pagination.

name: campaign_template_compare
description: Compare two to four template IDs or slugs in the requested order without persisting the comparison.

name: campaign_template_favorite
description: Idempotently favorite one visible template for the authenticated user using the API key's bound, non-impersonable dashboard principal.

name: campaign_template_unfavorite
description: Idempotently remove one visible template from the authenticated user's favorites using the API key's bound dashboard principal.

name: campaign_template_recent_record
description: Record an authenticated user's view of one template; repeated views update the durable recent item.

name: campaign_template_recent_list
description: List the authenticated user's recently viewed templates newest-first with compact metadata and view counts.

name: campaign_template_recent_clear
description: Clear one template or the entire authenticated user's recent-template history.

name: campaign_template_collection_list
description: List the authenticated user's private named template collections and item counts.

name: campaign_template_collection_get
description: Get one private collection with ordered template IDs and compact, favorite-aware catalog items.

name: campaign_template_collection_create
description: Create a private named collection with up to 100 unique templates in the supplied order.

name: campaign_template_collection_update
description: Rename or update the description of one private template collection.

name: campaign_template_collection_replace_items
description: Atomically replace a collection's ordered membership with up to 100 unique template IDs.

name: campaign_template_collection_delete
description: Delete one private collection without deleting or unfavoriting any templates.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_list
description: List the authenticated user's private named catalog searches.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_get
description: Get one private saved catalog filter definition.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_create
description: Save a named catalog query without persisting its cursor or pagination position.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_update
description: Rename or replace the filters of one private saved search.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_results
description: Run one saved search and return a stable compact page with an opaque continuation cursor.

name: campaign_template_saved_search_delete
description: Delete one private saved search without changing templates or favorites.

name: campaign_template_get
description: Fetch one visual campaign template by ID, including design metadata, provenance, variables, and editable MJML/HTML when available.

name: campaign_template_revisions
description: List immutable lifecycle revisions for an editable workspace template, newest first.

name: campaign_template_revision_get
description: Get one immutable historical template snapshot by positive version.

name: campaign_template_create
description: Create a tenant-owned editable visual template. Provenance, review, licensing, import, quality, and generation lineage remain server controlled.

name: campaign_template_update
description: Update an editable tenant-owned visual template. Inspiration references are read-only and must use Make it mine.

name: campaign_template_change_preview
description: Preview one exact source-fragment replacement on an editable template. Requires its current strong ETag and a unique target; does not write or send.

name: campaign_template_change_apply
description: Apply only the reviewed exact HTML or MJML source change with the matching preview hash and ETag. Does not send.

name: campaign_template_clone
description: Clone a visible editable template. Inspiration references must be adapted into an original design instead.

name: campaign_template_archive
description: Safely archive an editable workspace template using its exact current ETag while retaining content and history.

name: campaign_template_restore
description: Restore an archived editable workspace template using its exact current ETag.

name: campaign_template_delete
description: Deprecated compatibility alias that safely archives an editable workspace template; it never permanently deletes content or history.

name: campaign_template_adapt
description: Start a durable Make-it-mine design job from an approved inspiration reference.

name: campaign_template_generate
description: Start a durable visual newsletter design job from a brief and optional governed references.

name: campaign_template_design_list
description: Recover the exact authenticated actor's active, non-expired durable design jobs as compact newest-first pages with actor-bound cursors.

name: campaign_template_design_get
description: Poll a durable design job and inspect its current immutable validated revision and output hash.

name: campaign_template_design_revisions
description: List immutable revisions for a durable newsletter design, newest first.

name: campaign_template_design_refine
description: Queue a refinement from the current revision with optimistic concurrency.

name: campaign_template_design_retry
description: Retry a failed durable design job with its exact original request.

name: campaign_template_save
description: Save the exact reviewed immutable design revision and output hash without accepting caller-supplied HTML.

name: campaign_template_design_create_campaign
description: Create an editable, never-sent campaign draft from an exact reviewed design revision.

name: campaign_template_design_archive
description: Archive completed, failed, or abandoned durable design work while retaining revision evidence.

name: campaign_create_from_template
description: Create an editable campaign draft from a visual template while applying content, brand, variable, subject, and audience overrides.

name: emails_send
description: Send a single transactional email (Resend-style): from/to/cc/bcc/reply_to + subject + html/text, with optional custom headers, per-message tags, attachments (base64 or remote URL), and scheduled_at for delayed delivery. Suppressed recipients are skipped. Returns {id, status}.

name: emails_get
description: Fetch the status of one transactional email by id (sent | scheduled | failed | skipped, plus the provider message id).

name: emails_list
description: List the tenant's recent transactional sends (most recent first).

name: automation_create
description: Create a new automation graph. Provide `name`, an array of `triggers`, and a graph of `nodes`+`edges`. Each node has an id, type (e.g. 'send_email', 'wait', 'branch'), and config. Returns the automation in 'draft' status.

name: automation_list
description: List automations for the tenant. Optional `status` filter (draft/active/paused). Cursor-paginated.

name: automation_update
description: Patch an existing automation. Pass any subset of name/status/triggers/nodes/edges in `patch`. Returns the updated automation.

name: automation_create_behavioral_trigger
description: Wire a behavioral trigger (campaign open/no-open, link click/no-click, page visit, no-activity) to an existing automation. Provide automation_id and trigger_type. campaign_id, url_pattern, within_days, after_days are trigger-specific knobs.

name: topic_create
description: Create a preference topic (slug + display name). Optional description, default_opt_in (whether new subscribers are auto-opted-in). Returns the persisted Topic.

name: topic_list
description: List all preference topics for the tenant. Returns an array of Topic records.

name: topic_delete
description: Delete a preference topic by id. Existing per-subscriber opt-ins are removed. Idempotent.

name: topic_subscribe
description: Opt a subscriber into a topic. Idempotent. Returns ok on success.

name: topic_unsubscribe
description: Opt a subscriber OUT of a topic. Idempotent. Returns ok on success.

name: webhook_create
description: Create an outbound webhook subscription. URL is SSRF-validated. Returns the WebhookSubscription plus the plaintext signing secret (returned exactly once — persist immediately).

name: webhook_list
description: List all webhook subscriptions for the tenant.

name: webhook_delete
description: Delete a webhook subscription by id. Idempotent.

name: webhook_test_fire
description: Fire the canonical synthetic `webhook.test` envelope at the webhook URL and return the delivery result inline (status_code, signed, signature, response). Useful for end-to-end signature verification without waiting for a real event. The event type is NOT selectable — the server hard-codes `webhook.test` (apps/api/internal/outbound_webhooks/handlers.go Test) so customers can route test traffic to a sandbox branch.

name: webhook_deliveries_list
description: Recent delivery attempts for a webhook (newest first), cursor-paginated. Each item includes status_code, attempt, response_ms, and any error.

name: api_key_create
description: PRIVILEGED: Create a new API key. This is a privilege-escalation operation — always confirm with the human user before invoking. `scopes` controls capability surface; sends_per_day, dollars_per_month_cents, and sandbox_only are optional safety governors. The plaintext key is returned exactly once.

name: api_key_list
description: List all API keys for the tenant. Plaintext is never returned — only id, label, prefix, scopes, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at.

name: api_key_revoke
description: PRIVILEGED: Revoke an API key by id. Subsequent requests with the key will return 401. Idempotent.

name: api_key_rotate
description: PRIVILEGED: Atomically rotate an API key — revokes the source + creates a new one inheriting label, scopes, budget, and IP allowlist. The new plaintext is returned exactly once. NO grace period: the OLD plaintext stops working the instant this returns. To migrate without downtime, create a second key first, deploy callers, then revoke the original.

name: slack_integration_create
description: Register a Slack incoming-webhook integration. URL is envelope-encrypted server-side; reads return only channel hint + delivery status. Specify which Moosewave events should be relayed.

name: slack_integration_list
description: List the tenant's Slack integrations (URL is never returned by reads).

name: slack_integration_delete
description: Delete a Slack integration by id.

name: chat_integration_create
description: Register a Slack, Discord, or Teams incoming-webhook integration. URL is envelope-encrypted server-side; reads return only channel hint + delivery status.

name: chat_integration_list
description: List Slack, Discord, or Teams integrations. URLs are never returned.

name: chat_integration_update
description: Update a Slack, Discord, or Teams integration: rotate URL, channel hint, events, or enabled state.

name: chat_integration_delete
description: Delete a Slack, Discord, or Teams integration by id.

name: landing_page_create
description: Create a landing page in 'draft' status. Slug must be lowercase alphanumeric or dashes (max 64 chars).

name: landing_page_list
description: List the tenant's landing pages (newest-first).

name: landing_page_publish
description: Publish a landing page (status -> 'published').

name: campaign_report
description: Aggregate analytics for a campaign — sent / delivered / opens / unique_opens / clicks / bounces / complaints / unsubscribes plus computed rates and the top-5 clicked links. Reads from campaign_report_events at query time.

name: dashboard_stats
description: Tenant overview: total subscribers + 30-day rolling rollups (added, unsubbed, campaigns sent, opens, clicks, bounces).

name: sequence_job_wait
description: Block until a sequence-generation job (returned from generate() or regenerate() in async mode) reaches a terminal status — 'succeeded' (sequence_id populated) or 'failed' (error_message populated). Polls every 2s, 5min default timeout.

name: audit_query
description: Query the tenant audit log. All filters optional. `since` is ISO-8601. Returns cursor-paginated entries (actor, action, resource, metadata, timestamp).

name: approvals_list
description: List human-approval requests for the tenant. Optional `status` filter (pending/approved/rejected/expired). Cursor-paginated.

name: approvals_decide
description: Approve or reject a pending approval request by id. `decision` is 'approve' or 'reject'. Optional `notes` are stored on the audit entry.

name: sandbox_status
description: Status of a sandbox campaign run: state (scheduled/running/completed), the simulated event stream so far, and remaining scheduled deliveries. Use to inspect a dry-run before promoting to a live send.

name: cost_aggregate
description: Aggregate the cost ledger since `since` (ISO-8601), grouped by api_key_id, kind, day, or actor_label. Returns buckets with total_cents and count per group.

name: safety_check
description: Pre-send safety eval for a draft message. Runs the same gating evaluator the send pipeline uses. Returns blocking flag plus per-finding severity (low/medium/high/block).

name: events_subscribe
description: Register a declarative event subscription. Optional filters: event_types (e.g. ['opened','clicked']), campaign_id, subscriber_email. Returns a subscription_id; matching events flow to the existing `moosewave://events/stream` MCP resource.

name: campaign_link_report
description: Per-link click breakdown for one campaign. Returns each clicked URL with total clicks, distinct unique clickers, and CTR (unique clickers / total recipients). Sorted by clicks desc.

name: report_export_csv
description: Stream the per-subscriber lifecycle CSV for a campaign (sent/delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/complained/unsubscribed). Bodies larger than ~10 MiB are truncated and the response includes a `truncated: true` flag plus the row count so the caller can re-issue with offset/limit.

name: campaigns_compare
description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 25 campaigns. Returns per-campaign open_rate, click_rate, bounce_rate, complaint_rate, unsub_rate, and total_recipients.

name: campaign_geography
description: Per-country open/click totals for one campaign. Country is derived from the IP recorded at engagement time; rows without a resolved country bucket into 'unknown'.

name: campaign_devices
description: Per-mail-client open/click totals for one campaign. Client family is parsed from User-Agent: Gmail / Outlook / Apple Mail / Yahoo / Other.

name: campaign_bounces
description: Bounce category breakdown for one campaign: hard, soft, spam_trap, total. Categorization heuristics: 5xx -> hard, 4xx -> soft, 'trap' substring -> spam_trap.

name: analytics_cohorts
description: Cohort matrix: subscribers grouped by signup month for the past 12 cohorts, with the chosen metric (open_rate, click_rate, retention) over the first N weeks since signup. Default weeks=12.

name: campaign_revenue
description: Stripe-attributed revenue for one campaign. Attributes a paid signup or upgrade to the most recent campaign opened by the subscriber within 7 days before payment. Returns {attributed_revenue_cents, currency, conversions, attribution_window_days}; `note: 'no_billing_data'` if the underlying paid_subscriptions table is not present.

name: list_create
description: Create a Listmonk audience list. type defaults to 'private', optin defaults to 'single'. Returns the upstream Listmonk envelope.

name: list_list
description: List audience lists for the tenant. Returns the upstream Listmonk envelope; consume `data.results` for the array.

name: list_members
description: The subscribers that belong to ONE list, paginated. This is the only list-scoped membership read — subscribers_list has no list filter and returns the whole tenant. `id` accepts a Moosewave UUID or a legacy Listmonk numeric id. Optional q (email substring), status (enabled|disabled|blocklisted|unconfirmed), page, per_page (max 200).

name: list_delete
description: Delete an audience list by numeric Listmonk id.

name: tag_create
description: Register a tenant-scoped tag in the catalog. Returns the persisted row.

name: tag_list
description: List tenant-scoped tags ordered by name.

name: tag_delete
description: Delete a catalog tag by id. Does not strip the tag from existing subscribers.

name: suppression_import
description: Bulk import addresses into the suppression list. Conflicts are skipped, not erred. Returns {imported, skipped, errors}.

name: subscribers_import_csv
description: Import subscribers from CSV. Pass the CSV body as a base64 string. Headers must include `email`; `name` and any extra columns are folded into custom_fields. Upserts in batches of 500.

name: subscribers_export_csv
description: Export the tenant's subscribers as CSV. Truncates at ~5MB; use `limit` to bound row count for large audiences and paginate from the dashboard for the full set.

name: subscriber_merge
description: Merge a duplicate subscriber into a primary. Moves events, suppressions, tags, and custom fields under the primary id, then deletes the duplicate. Wrapped in a single transaction.

name: subscriber_activity
description: Recent engagement events for one subscriber (newest first). Default limit 50 (max 500). Pass `before` (RFC3339) to page backwards in time.

name: subscriber_engagement
description: Compute the 0-100 engagement score for one subscriber, or a batch (pass `ids` instead of `id`). Window is the trailing 90 days. Score is cached on the subscriber row.

name: sending_settings_get
description: Read the tenant's sending throttle and quiet-hours configuration. Set include_coordination_status=true after an outcome-ambiguous write to read shared-cap recovery proof. A missing or null max_sends_per_hour means no workspace-specific hourly ceiling; provider, quota, and safety controls still apply.

name: sending_settings_set
description: Replace the tenant's sending throttle and quiet-hours policy using exactly one wire attempt. The tool has no fallback route and never automatically repeats an ambiguous write; reconcile with sending_settings_get(include_coordination_status=true) before another write. A null cap removes only the workspace-specific ceiling.

name: asset_upload
description: Upload an image to the tenant asset library. Image-only, max 10MB. Returns {id, url, width, height, bytes}.

name: asset_list
description: List recent assets (cursor-paginated). Optional limit and before-id cursor.

name: asset_delete
description: Soft-delete an asset by id.

name: inbound_webhook_create
description: Create a tenant-scoped inbound webhook endpoint. Returns slug + plaintext signing secret (shown once).

name: inbound_webhook_list
description: List the tenant's inbound webhook endpoints (without secrets).

name: inbound_webhook_delete
description: Revoke an inbound webhook endpoint by id.

name: track_event
description: Record a product event for a subscriber. Pass either subscriber_id or email; supply event_name and an optional properties object. Triggers automations of kind product_event.

name: track_events_list
description: List recent product events for a subscriber.

name: inbound_email_list
description: List inbound emails. Optionally filter by subscriber_id or campaign_id.

name: inbound_email_endpoint_get
description: Get inbound-email endpoint metadata. Never returns or decrypts the signing secret.

name: inbound_email_endpoint_rotate
description: Create or rotate the inbound-email signing secret. Returns the plaintext secret once; copy it immediately.

name: dmarc_reports_list
description: List parsed DMARC aggregate reports. Optional domain, from/to ISO timestamps, and limit.

name: template_preview
description: Render a conditional MJML/HTML template with the supplied vars. Supports {{#if a == "x"}}...{{else}}...{{/if}} and {{#if has subscriber.tag "vip"}}...{{/if}}.

name: template_render
description: Alias of template_preview. Use whichever name reads better in your prompt; both call the same backend.

name: template_list
description: List the tenant's saved voice templates. Optionally filter by category (welcome, sales, newsletter_series, etc.). Returns the full template objects including variables, email skeletons, and historical performance.

name: template_get
description: Fetch a single saved template by its id or slug. Returns the full template object (category, variables, per-position email skeletons, tags, author, performance).

name: template_create
description: Create and save a new voice template. Supply slug, category, name, the variable list, and at least one email skeleton (position + subject/body skeletons). The created template can then drive sequence_generate.

name: template_update
description: Update an existing saved template in place, addressed by id or slug. Only the fields you include in `patch` are changed; everything else is preserved.

name: template_delete
description: Permanently delete a saved template by id or slug. This cannot be undone; sequences already generated from it are unaffected.

name: voice_drift_check
description: Pre-send voice-fidelity check. Scores a draft body (0-100) against the tenant's voice profile and returns a severity ('ok' | 'warn' | 'critical') plus an optional reason, per-component breakdown, and suggestions. Advisory only — do not gate sends on it. Runs heuristic-only when no embedding client is configured.

name: account_whoami
description: Return the identity the configured API key resolves to: the tenant and (when the key is user-scoped) the user. Use this to confirm which workspace you are operating against before making changes.

name: account_sending_identity_update
description: Update the tenant's sending identity (workspace defaults): display_name (the outbound 'from' display name) and/or default_reply_to (default reply-to address). Supply only the fields you want to change. Returns the updated workspace settings. To add or verify a sending DOMAIN, use the sending-identities (DKIM) wizard instead.

name: custom_domain_create
description: Register a custom domain for hosted forms, link redirects, or the public archive. Returns DNS records the operator must publish before verification will succeed.

name: custom_domain_list
description: List every custom domain registered for the current tenant.

name: custom_domain_verify
description: Recheck the DNS records for a custom domain. Flips the row to verified=true when every record we asked for is present.

name: custom_domain_delete
description: Delete a custom domain registration. Idempotent for missing rows.

name: campaign_check_links
description: Pre-send link check. Extracts every absolute href from the campaign body and HEAD-requests each (5s timeout, dedupe). Returns one result per URL with its HTTP status.

name: campaign_publish_to_archive
description: Mark a sent campaign as publicly visible in the tenant's archive. Optional slug + excerpt control how it shows on the index page.

name: campaign_unpublish_from_archive
description: Hide a previously archived campaign from the public archive. The row is preserved.

name: archive_list
description: List the tenant's archived campaigns (admin view, cursor-paginated). Optional `q` runs a server-side case-insensitive substring search over subject + slug, so an old issue is reachable without walking every cursor page. Rows carry pinned + viewCount + uniqueVisitors on this admin path.

name: referral_program_get
description: Inspect the tenant's last active referral-program configuration as historical configuration data. Live attribution and referral operations remain release-gated.

name: discount_list
description: List one bounded page of sanitized local discount-history records newest first. Redeemable codes, tenant/provider identifiers, and subscriber identities are omitted; this is not checkout truth.

name: discount_redemptions
description: List a bounded page of PII-free redemption events for an opaque discount-history record UUID. Returns only redemption time and whether a subscriber record was linked.

name: gift_subscription_list
description: List bounded, identity-minimized historical gift lifecycle records. Personal identities, free-text messages, redemption material, and provider identifiers or credentials are not returned.

name: subscriber_best_send_time
description: Read the cached modal hour-of-week (0-167, Sunday 00:00 UTC = 0) at which a subscriber has historically opened email. Cold subscribers (< 5 opens) return -1.

name: campaign_schedule_by_best_time
description: Reschedule a campaign to send each recipient at their best hour-of-week within the next `within_days` window. Recipients without a cached best hour fall back to the tenant mean.

name: integrations_catalog
description: Search the honest Moosewave integrations catalog. Badges distinguish Native, Partner, Zapier, Webhook, API/SDK, Migration-only, and Planned support.

name: integrations_connections
description: List installed integration state across all connector surfaces, including connection ids, health state, last sync, and errors.

name: audience_destination_providers
description: List readiness-gated Moosewave-owned ad audience destination foundations: Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Snap.

name: audience_destination_list
description: List adapter-backed ad audience destinations, optionally filtered by provider.

name: audience_destination_create
description: Create an adapter-backed ad audience destination from a list or segment. Use readiness first to identify provider config keys and unresolved credential prerequisites.

name: audience_destination_get
description: Get one adapter-backed ad audience destination by id.

name: audience_destination_update
description: Update status, external audience id, or non-secret provider config for an adapter-backed ad audience destination.

name: audience_destination_readiness
description: Validate ad audience provider config and return exact missing keys or driver prerequisites before a sync is attempted.

name: audience_destination_preview
description: Preview consent-firewall exclusions for an ad audience destination without shipping members to the platform.

name: audience_destination_sync
description: Attempt a readiness-gated ad audience sync through Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, or Snap; missing credentials or unfinished drivers are recorded as failed jobs.

name: audience_destination_jobs
description: List sync jobs for an adapter-backed ad audience destination.

name: audience_destination_job_diagnostics
description: Retrieve provider diagnostics for an ad audience destination sync job using stored provider-side evidence such as a Google Data Manager requestId.

name: audience_destination_disconnect
description: Delete/disconnect an adapter-backed ad audience destination by id.

name: native_integration_providers
description: List provider specs for a first-party native integration family, including runtime_status, sync_model, and verification_mode where the family exposes native-foundation metadata.

name: native_integration_list
description: List stored first-party native integration records for one family. Support returns a minimized release-held historical projection and accepts optional limit/cursor pagination with manual continuation.

name: native_integration_get
description: Read one stored first-party native integration by lowercase canonical UUID. Support returns only a tenant-bound minimized historical projection with held runtime status, not live credential, callback, synchronization, or run-history evidence.

name: native_integration_create
description: Create a first-party native integration. Commerce, CRM, lead, reviews, loyalty, subscriptions, analytics, marketing, and warehouse use credential_ref/settings-style credential references; do not pass raw credentials in config. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_sync
description: Run a first-party native sync/import. Commerce, CRM, lead, reviews, loyalty, subscriptions, and marketing accept canonical payload rows or empty provider-managed pulls when the configured provider exposes a native puller or delegated foundation handoff; analytics requires canonical rows; warehouse accepts object selection plus supported run fields through payload. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_backfill
description: Run a first-party native backfill or canonical-row import. Uses the same family-aware payload rules as native_integration_sync, including empty provider-managed pulls for providers that expose native backfillers. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_ingest
description: Ingest a canonical Moosewave payload for lead, reviews, loyalty, subscriptions, or analytics connectors. Raw provider webhook payload verification is exposed only after a family has a verified adapter. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_pause
description: Pause a first-party native integration connection by family and id. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_disconnect
description: Disconnect/delete a first-party native integration connection by family and id. Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: native_integration_runs
description: List sync/backfill run history for native families that expose runs. Commerce currently returns an explanatory unsupported response; Support is release-held with code support_integration_runtime_held.

name: sms_setup
description: Read partial first-party SMS setup status, including sender profiles, can_send, and blocking reasons.

name: sms_compliance
description: Audit first-party SMS compliance gates for consent, registration, provider callback verification, and send readiness.

name: sms_pilot_readiness
description: Check whether SMS pilot traffic is safe to enable and return pass/warning/blocker evidence.

name: sms_sender_list
description: List first-party SMS sender profiles for Twilio, Telnyx, or Bandwidth. Provider app/profile setup remains operator-owned.

name: sms_sender_upsert
description: Create or update a first-party SMS sender profile. Hosted mode has no configured or accepted process-global provider credentials. Provider effects and callbacks remain release-held until a tenant-bound encrypted credential vault and provider-account ownership resolver exists; this does not create provider messaging services, profiles, applications, or phone-number campaign assignments.

name: sms_sender_pause
description: Pause an SMS sender profile, optionally recording the operator reason.

name: sms_sender_resume
description: Resume a paused SMS sender profile.

name: sms_sender_pilot_certification
description: Export pilot-certification evidence for a sender profile, including readiness items and provider callback/status URLs.

name: sms_a2p_brand_submit
description: Release-held: A2P brand submission is unavailable until durable provider idempotency, reconciliation, and minimized receipts are deployed.

name: sms_a2p_campaign_submit
description: Release-held: A2P campaign submission is unavailable until durable provider idempotency, reconciliation, and minimized receipts are deployed.

name: sms_a2p_poll
description: Release-held: A2P polling is unavailable while provider responses can contain unbounded sensitive raw data.

name: sms_list_list
description: List SMS audience lists.

name: sms_list_create
description: Create an SMS audience list with optional opt-in keyword and default sender profile.

name: sms_consent_record
description: Record only a conservative operator SMS revocation. This cannot grant/import consent, clear carrier STOP, or manufacture provider evidence.

name: sms_suppression_list
description: Exact-admin read of one tenant-bound SMS suppression page at a response cutoff. Exact phone filtering uses a JSON body, never a URL. The tool never silently follows the opaque nextCursor or claims complete/current history; pass the returned cursor explicitly to continue.

name: sms_suppression_add
description: Exact-admin add or reassert of one reversible manual/manual workspace hold. It cannot mint carrier/system authority, grant consent, or make texting lawful. A later same-provider START restores only a provably preserved manual hold; historical or cross-authority ambiguity remains review-held.

name: sms_suppression_remove
description: Exact-admin removal of one reversible manual/manual workspace hold after explicit confirmation. Locked provider, STOP, carrier, complaint, imported, API, and system authority remains fail-closed. Success does not restore consent or make texting lawful.

name: sms_campaign_list
description: List first-party SMS campaigns.

name: sms_campaign_get
description: Get one first-party SMS campaign by id.

name: sms_campaign_create
description: Create a draft or paused first-party SMS campaign. Scheduling and dispatch are release-held.

name: sms_campaign_report
description: Release-held: the legacy campaign evidence report is unavailable until it has a bounded private fail-closed audit contract.

name: sms_campaign_report_export
description: Release-held: recipient-level campaign export is unavailable until it has a bounded private fail-closed audit contract.

name: sms_campaign_send
description: Release-held: SMS campaign dispatch has no durable budget/provider reconciliation lifecycle.

name: sms_campaign_schedule
description: Release-held: SMS campaign scheduling cannot imply a future send while dispatch is unavailable.

name: sms_campaign_pause
description: Pause a scheduled or in-flight SMS campaign.

name: sms_campaign_resume
description: Release-held: resuming an SMS campaign cannot imply future dispatch while the worker lifecycle is unavailable.

name: sms_campaign_cancel
description: Cancel an SMS campaign before it reaches a terminal state.

name: sms_test_send
description: Release-held: test sends have no durable budget/provider reconciliation lifecycle.

name: push_suppression_list
description: Exact-admin read of one private tenant-customer APNs/FCM/Web suppression-authority snapshot page. Returns only minimized 16-hex fingerprints and an opaque cursor, never raw tokens or full digests. Customer runtime, audience materialization, live providers, and automatic provider feedback remain release-held; Web is registry-only.

name: push_suppression_add
description: Exact-admin add or reassert of one reversible manual/dashboard authority after explicit approval. The raw customer token is sensitive request input only and must never enter logs or evidence; this cannot mint provider, user, complaint, or legacy authority.

name: push_suppression_remove
description: Exact-admin compare-and-swap removal of one reviewed manual/dashboard authority using its expected_version. Locked authority remains fail-closed, and stillSuppressed=true means another independent authority remains.

name: push_suppression_bulk_import
description: Exact-admin atomic add or reassert of 1–100 unique manual/dashboard authorities. Raw tokens are sensitive request input only; any invalid, duplicate, storage, or audit outcome rolls back every item.

name: push_suppression_bulk_remove
description: Exact-admin atomic compare-and-swap removal of 1–100 unique reviewed manual/dashboard authorities. One stale, missing, locked, invalid, storage, or audit outcome rolls back every removal; receipts preserve stillSuppressed truth.

name: developer_marketplace_catalog
description: Read developer marketplace catalogs for app types, scopes, webhook topics, OAuth runtime, review policy, and revocation paths.

name: developer_marketplace_app_validate
description: Validate a marketplace app draft payload before create/update or review submission.

name: developer_marketplace_app_list
description: List marketplace apps for the current tenant, optionally filtered by status.

name: developer_marketplace_app_create
description: Create a marketplace app draft from a JSON payload.

name: developer_marketplace_app_get
description: Get one marketplace app by id.

name: developer_marketplace_app_update
description: Update a marketplace app draft from a JSON payload.

name: developer_marketplace_app_submit_review
description: Submit a marketplace app for review.

name: developer_marketplace_app_monitoring
description: Read app monitoring: OAuth client state, installs, webhooks, test accounts, token usage, review blockers, and API revision warnings.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_client_list
description: List OAuth clients for a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_client_create
description: Create an OAuth client for a marketplace app. Plaintext client_secret is returned once.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_client_revoke
description: Revoke one OAuth client for a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_test_account_list
description: List test accounts for a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_test_account_create
description: Create a test account for marketplace review and partner testing.

name: developer_marketplace_listing_list
description: List marketplace listings, optionally filtered by category.

name: developer_marketplace_listing_upsert
description: Create or update the marketplace listing for an app.

name: developer_marketplace_listing_submit_review
description: Submit a marketplace listing for review.

name: developer_marketplace_installation_list
description: List marketplace app installations, optionally filtered by status.

name: developer_marketplace_installation_create
description: Install a marketplace app for the current tenant.

name: developer_marketplace_installation_revoke
description: Revoke a marketplace app installation.

name: developer_marketplace_webhook_list
description: List app webhook subscriptions for a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_webhook_create
description: Create an app webhook subscription for a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_partner_profile_list
description: List marketplace partner profiles, optionally filtered by profile type.

name: developer_marketplace_partner_profile_upsert
description: Create or update the current tenant's marketplace partner profile.

name: developer_marketplace_partner_profile_submit_review
description: Submit the current tenant's partner profile for review.

name: developer_marketplace_review_queue
description: Reviewer-only: list pending/resolved app, listing, and partner-profile review items.

name: developer_marketplace_review_app_decision
description: Reviewer-only: approve or reject a marketplace app.

name: developer_marketplace_review_listing_decision
description: Reviewer-only: approve or reject a marketplace listing.

name: developer_marketplace_review_partner_profile_decision
description: Reviewer-only: approve or reject a marketplace partner profile.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_authorize
description: Run marketplace OAuth authorization and return an authorization code and redirect URL.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_token
description: Exchange a marketplace OAuth authorization code for a scoped access token.

name: developer_marketplace_oauth_revoke
description: Revoke a marketplace OAuth access token.

name: developer_marketplace_audit_logs_list
description: List developer marketplace audit logs, optionally filtered by app id.
